answer: SELECT language FROM foreign_data WHERE multiverseid = 149934;
SELECT c.id, c.artist FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.power = '*' AND l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal';
SELECT DISTINCT s.isForeignOnly FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code WHERE c.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN layout='normal' AND text IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) FROM cards;
SELECT c.name FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic' AND l.format = 'gladiator' AND l.status = 'Banned';
SELECT count(*) FROM cards WHERE originalType = 'Summon - Angel' AND subtypes <> 'Angel';
SELECT CAST(count(DISTINCT f.uuid) AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT count(*) FROM cards) FROM foreign_data f WHERE f.language = 'Chinese Simplified';

SELECT l.format, c.name FROM legalities l JOIN cards c ON l.uuid = c.uuid WHERE l.status = 'Banned' AND l.format = (SELECT format FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1);

SELECT CAST(count(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT count(*) FROM cards WHERE power IS NULL) FROM cards c JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid WHERE c.power IS NULL AND f.language = 'French';
SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo FROM cards c JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid GROUP BY c.uuid ORDER BY count(r.id) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT st.translation FROM cards c JOIN set_translations st ON c.setCode = st.setCode WHERE c.name = "Ancestor's Chosen" AND st.language = 'Italian';
